{"code": "import math

# Manually compute binomial probability using log-sum-exp to avoid overflow
# We want P(X <= k) where X ~ Binomial(n, 0.5)
# Use log probabilities and sum in log space

# Log of 0.5
log_p = math.log(0.5)

# Compute log of P(X = i)
log_prob = lambda i, n: i * log_p + (n - i) * log_p + math.lgamma(n + 1) - math.lgamma(i + 1) - math.lgamma(n - i + 1)

# Sum log probabilities from 0 to k
log_p_cum = -float('inf')
for i in range(k + 1):
    log_p_i = log_prob(i, n)
    if log_p_i == -float('inf'):
        continue
    if log_p_cum == -float('inf'):
        log_p_cum = log_p_i
    else:
        log_p_cum = math.logaddexp(log_p_cum, log_p_i)

# Two-sided p-value
p_val_sign_test = 2 * math.exp(log_p_cum)

# Print result
print(f"Sign test for median = 0 (manual):")
print(f"- Positive changes: {positive_count}")
print(f"- Negative changes: {negative_count}")
print(f"- Zero changes: {zero_count}")
print(f"- Total non-zero: {n}")
print(f"- Test statistic (k): {k}")
print(f"- Two-sided p-value: {p_val_sign_test:.6f}")"}
